chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās, from ‘Abd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ḥarīz, from ‘Īsā ibn ‘Abd Allāh al-Qummī, from Abī ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام used to make up twenty witr prayers in one night.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Ja‘far, the Imam being described in the report
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific used for the Imam
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he would make up or perform as qaḍā’

ai.seo_question: Did Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام make up multiple witr prayers in one night?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a devotional practice of Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام concerning making up missed witr prayers in a single night. It reflects the significance of supererogatory prayer and provides a precedent relevant to discussions of night prayer and making up missed recommended acts of worship.
